title: Nacelles and Pylons — Fan Cowl Doors — Install the Stiffened Hinge Beam and the Aft Intercostal Set
abstract: Mandatory conversion of the fan cowl doors to the stiffened hinge beam standard, adding two aft intercostals and a hinge fitting gusset after in-service distortion made the aft latch alignment marginal.

sections.planning_reason: Line stations reported increasing difficulty closing the fan cowl doors on older aircraft, with the aft latch needing to be pulled into engagement by hand. Measurement of eighteen doors showed a consistent permanent set at the aft hinge station that grows with door opening cycles rather than with flight hours. A door that has to be forced closed is a door that can be left unlatched, and the consequence of an unlatched fan cowl door in flight is well understood. The airworthiness authority issued a directive requiring conversion.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin gives the instructions to remove the fan cowl doors, to install the spar cap along the full length of the hinge beam, to install the two intercostals at the aft hinge stations and the gusset at the aft hinge fitting, and to re-restrain the drain line that the new intercostals displace. The work is carried out with the door in a jig off the aircraft. The latch keeper positions are unchanged so that a converted door and an unconverted door can both be latched to the same nacelle.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Remove the fan cowl doors using AMM-T-54-10-12-000-002-A and set them in the door jig. Remove the drain line clamps and set the line aside. Clean and inspect the hinge beam and record any existing damage before starting; a door with damage beyond limits must be assessed before conversion. Drill the intercostal positions from the template supplied with the kit, not to a datum. Install the spar cap along the hinge beam and torque to the values in the installation drawing. Install both intercostals and the aft hinge fitting gusset. Re-restrain the drain line with new cable ties, clear of the new intercostals. Do the eddy current inspection of the new fastener rows. Restore the door protective treatment. Install the doors using AMM-T-54-10-12-400-002-A and do the latch alignment and closing force check. Record the modification and update the configuration record.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to Auran powered TTN-88W1 and TTN-88W2 aircraft. CVX-7270 powered aircraft carry a different door and are outside this effectivity. Aircraft delivered from MSN T00175 have the stiffened door from the production line. Doors may be converted individually and a mixed pair is acceptable in service.
sections.material_note: Kit K5410-1017-01 covers one door. Order four kits per aircraft. The spar cap is the long-lead item at eighteen weeks. Operators are encouraged to convert a spare door pair first and to rotate it through the fleet, because the door can be released to service while its own doors are in the shop.

type_data.compliance_time: Within 36 months after the effective date of the associated airworthiness directive, or at the next door removal, whichever occurs first.
